note: A three-note tune that plays two of its notes twice, one note per beat from the tab. The old Key selector is now moves (any key, 60 to 80 bpm): the app brings the second key, and the {{?key}} line says what stays the same in it.

exercise.title: A tune that repeats its notes
exercise.why: This tune has only three notes and plays two of them twice, so there are only three frets to find and the new job is giving each note its beat.

cells.text:
Press Play below to hear the tune at {{=bpm}}, then play along from the tab, one note per beat until the long last note.
Practice until you can hum the tune before you play it.
{{?key}}In another key the tune sits on other frets and keeps its shape: a note twice, a step lower twice, then the home note.
